$comment: Every third-party input the browser-local SOPS work depends on, pinned. The dependency list is asserted by src/lib/sops/boundaries.test.ts, which fails if it grows.

compatibilityTarget.role: Build-time conformance oracle only. Never shipped, never invoked by the browser; fetched once, verified against the checksums published with the release, then run with an empty environment and no plugin or key-service discovery.

shippedDependencies.name: age-encryption
shippedDependencies.role: age X25519 recipient and identity envelopes

shippedDependencies.name: @noble/ciphers
shippedDependencies.role: AES-256-GCM with the 32-byte nonce SOPS writes; WebCrypto is not used here because Go uses cipher.NewGCMWithNonceSize and no nonce may be truncated or rehashed

shippedDependencies.name: yaml
shippedDependencies.role: YAML syntax only — the engine owns scalar resolution and the emitted bytes, because go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 resolves plain scalars differently and the MAC depends on it

browserPrimitives.name: WebCrypto SHA-512 / SHA-256
browserPrimitives.role: the document MAC and the mac_only_encrypted initialization

browserPrimitives.name: crypto.getRandomValues
browserPrimitives.role: data keys, Shamir shares, and record nonces

browserPrimitives.name: Module Web Worker
browserPrimitives.role: the engine runs off the main thread

browserPrimitives.name: File System Access / download
browserPrimitives.role: reading and writing the document, with no server in between

writtenHere.name: SOPS engine
writtenHere.reason: there is no browser SOPS implementation to depend on

writtenHere.name: yaml.v3 scalar resolution
writtenHere.reason: base-0 integers, timestamp layouts and uint64 refusal decide a scalar type, and the type decides the MAC

writtenHere.name: RE2 subset engine
writtenHere.reason: JavaScript RegExp is a different language with backtracking; a selector from an imported .sops.yaml must not be a denial of service

writtenHere.name: Shamir GF(2^8)
writtenHere.reason: must match upstream 33-byte {y1..y32, x} share layout exactly
